events.verdict: Robinson (DET) brings his hands toward White (BOS) and the contact during the pick is marginal.
White (BOS) directly contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Cunningham's hand after the release.
Robinson (DET) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) moves alongside Cunningham's (DET) path on the perimeter.
Robinson (DET) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Simons' (BOS) jersey off-ball.
Simons (BOS) is firming up over his left leg in Green's (DET) path prior to the contact.
White (BOS) loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of any contact from Green (DET).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Simons (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Simons dislodges the ball from Robinson (DET) and Robinson is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Celtics.
Cunningham (DET) legally contests Pritchard's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pistons.
White (BOS) initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm prior to making any contact with the ball.
Cunningham (DET) releases away from White (BOS) to receive the inbound pass.
Simons (BOS) commits a take foul on Robinson (DET).
Robinson (DET) legally contests Simons' (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Duren (DET) briefly grasps Queta's (BOS) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
